第一卷 第35章 奇怪的副作用-《我养的AI竟是京圈太子爷》

两人玩了一天，夜色浓黑时，才想起回家。

地铁站还有一段路。霖多多的新鞋有点磨脚，走了这么久，疼痛感越发强烈，步伐明显慢了下来，一瘸一拐的。

上官程走了几步，发现身后的人落后了。

他停下来，回过头。

女孩站在路灯下，低着头，单脚站着，另一只脚的脚尖轻轻点在地上，似乎在偷偷地、不让人发现地缓解脚上的疼痛。

他走回去，在她面前蹲了下来。

“上来。”他说，“我背你。”

霖多多的脸“唰”地红了。

“不用不用，我能走——”

“上来。”

声音不大，但语气里有一种不容拒绝的笃定。

霖多多犹豫了一秒，然后弯起嘴角，像孩子一样，笑着扑了上去。

上官程稳稳地接住她，双手托住她的腿弯，站起来，迈开步子。

他的背很宽，比她想象的要宽得多。

步伐很稳，不快不慢，每一步都踩得踏踏实实。

路灯一盏一盏地从头顶掠过，光影交替。

霖多多觉得自己像躺在一艘小船上，晃晃悠悠的，很舒服。

她的眼皮越来越沉，竟是睡着了。

上官程感觉到背上的人呼吸变得均匀绵长，挑唇笑了笑。

地铁站就在前面。

他不想叫醒她。

他转了方向，朝另一条路走去。

那里有他在市中心的一套公寓。不大，复式，两百多平，平时没人住，但保洁阿姨每周都会来打扫。

他走得很稳，每一步都小心翼翼的，怕颠醒她。

月光把两个人的影子拉得很长很长，叠在一起，像一个。

The two played together all day, and it was only when the night became dark that they thought of going home.

The subway station is still some way away.Lin Duoduo's new shoes were a bit scratchy on her feet. After walking for so long, the pain became more and more intense. Her pace slowed down significantly and she was limping.

Shangguan Cheng walked a few steps and found that the people behind him were lagging behind.

He stopped and looked back.

The girl stood under the streetlight, her head lowered, standing on one foot, and the toe of her other foot gently tapped on the ground, seeming to secretly relieve the pain in her foot without being noticed.

He walked back and knelt down in front of her.

"Come up," he said, "I'll carry you."

Lin Duoduo's face turned red.

"No, no, no, I can go -"

"Come up."

The voice was not loud, but there was a determination in his tone that could not be rejected.

Lin Duoduo hesitated for a second, then curled up the corners of his mouth, smiled like a child, and rushed forward.

Shangguan Cheng caught her steadily, held her legs with both hands, stood up, and took steps forward.

His back was wide, much wider than she had imagined.

The pace is very steady, neither fast nor slow, and every step is firm.

Streetlights passed overhead one by one, alternating light and shadow.

Lin Duoduo felt like she was lying on a small boat, rocking and swaying, very comfortable.

Her eyelids became heavier and heavier, and she actually fell asleep.

Shangguan Cheng felt the breathing of the person on his back became even and long, and he raised his lips and smiled.

The metro station is right in front.

He didn't want to wake her.

He turned and headed another way.

There he had an apartment in the city center.It's not big, a duplex, more than 200 square meters. No one lives in it, but the cleaning lady comes to clean it every week.

He walked very steadily, taking every step carefully so as not to wake her up.

The moonlight stretched the shadows of the two people very long, stacked together, like one.
